spanish.title: Build your first sentences
spanish.goal: Say who you are, ask for something, and hear the sounds in the words.

spanish.title: Keep an exchange moving
spanish.goal: Clarify, ask directions, make a plan and describe ordinary routines.

spanish.title: Tell a story and carry a conversation
spanish.goal: Connect past events and background, then adapt a complete exchange.

piano.title: Find notes and keep time
piano.goal: Use keyboard landmarks, finger routes and staff positions to play a short tune.

piano.title: Make harmony with both hands
piano.goal: Build chords, coordinate the hands and connect C, F and G.

piano.title: Shape a complete piece
piano.goal: Count through groups and rests, shape a phrase and prepare a performance.

chess.title: Read the position and legal replies
chess.goal: Follow moves, answer checks and count both sides of a capture sequence.

chess.title: Develop pieces and calculate tactics
chess.goal: Give opening moves a purpose, castle legally, and inspect forks and pins.

chess.title: Convert an ending and study a game
chess.goal: Inspect promotions, count a pawn race and verify a mating net.

calculus.title: From a rule to a rate
calculus.goal: Connect functions, the required algebra, interval rates and an instantaneous rate.

calculus.title: Differentiate and use the result
calculus.goal: Account for products and linked changes, then choose an optimal value.

calculus.title: Accumulate and integrate
calculus.goal: Connect graph area with antiderivatives, bounds and substitution.

physics.title: Describe the motion
physics.goal: Keep units and signs consistent and read a velocity graph.

physics.title: Explain changes in motion
physics.goal: Use forces, energy and momentum with a stated object or system.

physics.title: Electricity, waves and fluids
physics.goal: Follow circuit paths and relate wave and pressure quantities to a model.
